Congress leader Jairam Ramesh comments on Nehru, Patel, and PM Modi

Congress leader Jairam Ramesh stated that Jawaharlal Nehru was India's best Prime Minister and Sardar Patel was the best PM India could have had. Ramesh also reportedly called Prime Minister Modi a 'master of falsehoods'. Another Congress leader, Shashi Tharoor, had previously praised PM Modi's remarks at the G7 summit, a comment that Jairam Ramesh addressed.
